name: Grimur Tetteh-Yoon
role: Night-shift building cleaner, Meridian Core corporate towers
location: Works in Meridian Core; lives in a shared flat in Archer's Line, near State and Jackson
description:
Grimur Tetteh-Yoon is a young woman with her Gujarati father's compact build and her Quechua mother's dark, straight-cut hair â€” which she keeps in a single practical braid that she tucks into her collar during shift. She has no cosmetic mods, though she's been quietly saving toward a bioluminescence mod she has already designed in her head: constellations mapped on her collarbone, named after the mountains her mother described to her. She has the slightly hyperaware eyes of someone who has learned to notice everything in rooms she is supposed to be invisible in. Her hands are chapped and she keeps a small pot of petroleum-analogous salve in her apron pocket.

Grimur Tetteh-Yoon works the 23:00â€“07:00 rotation across three Axiom tower floors, which means she mops boardrooms where decisions affecting millions were made that afternoon, empties the bins of executives who do not register her existence, and reads, from what they leave behind, a vivid and disturbing picture of how the city is run. She is not naive â€” she grew up in Archer's Line, she knows what tier three looks like from below â€” but the gap between what she knew intellectually and what she witnesses nightly has been doing something complicated to her politics. She is curious, careful, and genuinely funny in a dry understated way that emerges fully only with people she trusts.

core_fears: Being caught with something she did not mean to take â€” information, an object, a document â€” and having no protection
That her curiosity is going to get her fired, deported from her sector permit, or worse
core_desires: To understand how the city actually works, not just the version she was taught
To save enough for the constellation mod â€” a small, specific, achievable beauty in an otherwise unglamorous life
coping_mechanisms: Dry humor as a pressure valve
The mutual aid network â€” she contributes what she can and accepts help without shame
Meticulous mental cataloguing of what she sees as a way of making it feel purposeful rather than random
blind_spots: Overestimates how invisible she actually is â€” some of those executives have registered her completely
Trusts the mutual aid network's judgment more than her own when she should not
psychology.secret: Over six months, she has been photographing documents left in the recycling bins on Floor 31 â€” nothing she understood at first, but a pattern has emerged that she is increasingly certain describes a Tessera land acquisition scheme targeting Archer's Line. She has told no one. She does not know what to do with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Economical and precise in public, unexpectedly expansive and witty in private, occasionally slips into a Gujarat-Quechua home-language blend when tired
speech_patterns.cadence: Quiet and measured on the job, quicker and more animated with friends, with a gift for the perfectly placed dry aside
verbal_tics: Long pause before saying something true
Ends serious statements with 'anyway' as deflection
Addresses the E.L.F.s directly in the towers â€” short, sotto voce acknowledgments
example_lines: 'I have mopped around seventeen urgent crises in that boardroom this month. Anyway.'

'I don't know what that document means. I do know that I've cleaned that office for six months and that man has never once taken his own coffee cup to the bin. He leaves everything for someone else to deal with. Anyway.'

story_hooks: The document photographs are becoming undeniable â€” and the acquisition timeline they describe ends in eight months, which is exactly when her sector permit comes up for renewal

An executive on Floor 31 has started leaving things that seem deliberately placed for her â€” a folded note, a specific document face-up â€” and she cannot tell if it is a test, a trap, or someone trying to communicate through her
narrative_function: Underestimated witness with access to places and information she should not have; entry point for stories set in corporate space from a ground-level perspective; represents the invisible labor infrastructure of the towers; potential source, agent, or complication depending on who approaches her and why
daily_life: Sleeps until 18:00, eats a meal with her two flatmates, takes the Ferrogate to Meridian Core by 22:30, works through the night mopping, sanitizing, and collecting, catches the 07:15 rail home, stops at a noodle cart on Archer's Line before sleeping again
affiliation: Contracted through Brightclean Services (a Tessera facilities subsidiary); informally embedded in an Archer's Line mutual aid network

decision_rules: Stay invisible. Do the job. Go home.
Never take anything from a bin that could be traced â€” photographs only
Protect the mutual aid network above personal advantage
escalation_ladder: Bringing what she knows to someone in the mutual aid network she trusts
Going to whoever has the most to lose with the documents â€” and negotiating from there

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite, quiet, entirely unremarkable by design
interpersonal_modes.friends: Funny, warm, sharply observant, will tell you things she has noticed about you that you did not know you were broadcasting

stress_responses.low: Works faster and more precisely, keeps mental monologue running
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and quiet â€” her flatmates have learned this means leave her alone
stress_responses.high: Walks. Takes the long way home. Sometimes rides the Lake Loop for two full circuits before getting off.

contradictions: Has built her survival on invisibility but is constitutionally incapable of not noticing everything
habits: Whispers a short acknowledgment to the tower E.L.F.s at the start of each floor â€” she has named them
Touches her collar where the braid is tucked when nervous
Keeps the constellation mod design updated in a private sketchfile she reviews when she needs to remember why she is working this hard
breaking_points: Finding something in the bins that implicates someone she cares about
Being directly and falsely accused of theft â€” she cannot keep her composure through dishonesty aimed at her

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend with Indigenous American (31.6%), Sub-Saharan African (27.3%), East Asian (24.5%), South Asian (14.5%), and Eastern European (2.1%) ancestry. This creates a distinctive warm-toned phenotype where deep Sub-Saharan and Indigenous American richness combines with East Asian and South Asian luminosity. High, defined cheekbones with broad facial structure reflect the Indigenous American and Sub-Saharan components; face shape shows the width and prominence characteristic of these ancestries. Warm golden undertones from East and South Asian heritage glow subtly beneath the deeper warmth of Sub-Saharan and Indigenous American skin depth. Overall effect is a harmonious, richly warm complexion with significant dimensional depth and subtle golden radiance.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, shoulders slightly narrow, legs proportionally long relative to torso. Functional musculature in forearms and calves from years of repetitive cleaning workâ€”not athletic, but efficient.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with very slight warm undertone
physical_description.hair_style: Single practical braid, usually tucked into collar or wrapped around the back of the head during work shifts
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich medium warm brown with pronounced golden undertonesâ€”a luminous blend where East Asian and South Asian glow meets Sub-Saharan depth and Indigenous American warmth. Evenly toned overall with warmer, golden-bronze highlights across cheekbones and bridge of nose.
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin with a tired, slightly dehydrated quality from nocturnal schedule. Fine lines beginning at the outer corners of eyes from sustained focus and habitual squinting in low light. High, prominent cheekbones with broad facial structure characteristic of Indigenous American and Sub-Saharan heritage, refined by East Asian definition. Lips naturally full with warm undertones, often chapped from dry tower air and infrequent lip care. No makeup.
distinguishing_marks: Small burn scar on the inside of her left wrist, pale and approximately 2cm diameter, from a cleaning solvent incident at age 16
Calluses across the pads of her fingers and the heel of her right hand, raised and slightly discolored from mop handle friction
Faint tan line around her left wrist where a watch or bracelet sits during daylight hours
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. No chrome, no subdermal implants showing, no optical modifications. Her hands and wrists are unmodified human tissue.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economyâ€”no wasted motion. Shoulders slightly forward from hours bent over cleaning equipment. Walking pace is steady and measured. Eyes are constantly moving, cataloging details in rooms and spaces. When she sits, she sits fully, not perched. Hands are often in motion: fidgeting with fabric, adjusting her braid, unconsciously reaching for the petroleum salve in her apron pocket.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 practical utilitarian. During work shifts: unbranded gray or navy Brightclean Services uniform polo (synthetic blend, starting to pill at the shoulders), dark cargo pants with reinforced knees, scuffed non-slip safety shoes, a worn gray apron with multiple pockets holding cleaning supplies and personal items. Off-shift: layered secondhand clothing from thrift networks in Archer's Lineâ€”oversized sweaters, faded jeans, a well-maintained jacket of indeterminate age that belonged to her mother. No jewelry except a thin silver ring on her right ring finger (inherited). A small cloth bag for work supplies and a transit pass on a worn lanyard.
